item.description:
Ciklum is looking for an Expert Full Stack Engineer to join our team full-time in Ukraine.

The team is part of the Enterprise Security Engineering organization and the AI Engineering group. Desirable:

  • Experience building AI/ML-powered production features, or working in security, infrastructure-heavy, Big Data, or Spark environments

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership from design to production, and collaborate effectively across teams

  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy radical flexibility — work remotely or from an office, your choice

About us:

As one of Ukraine’s largest IT companies and a top employer recognized by Forbes, we’ve spent over 20 years delivering meaningful tech solutions. We proudly support diverse talent and military veterans, recognizing their unique skills and perspectives they bring to shaping the future.

item.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (Python, LLM & RAG) в DOIT Software, віддалено
item.description:
DOIT Software is looking for an AI/ML Engineer to join the engineering team of a B2B SaaS product company and build machine learning and AI features into its platform.

About the Client

Our client is a SaaS product company working in analyst relations (AR) and B2B influencer relations. Its platform helps technology vendors and B2B companies manage, track, and measure their relationships with industry analysts who influence buyers in the market.

The product combines a specialized CRM with a searchable database of analysts and influencers, analytics and reporting dashboards (share of voice, sentiment, competitive intelligence), and an analyst-facing self-service portal.

About the Role

You will design Python-based models and services, integrate large language models (Anthropic’s Claude), and ship them alongside the client’s software engineering team.

The platform runs on Angular, C# (.NET), SQL Server and MongoDB. You will not be the primary developer on that stack, but you will work in it daily: pulling data from it, exposing your models to it through APIs, and pairing with engineers to get AI features into production.

You will report to the VP of Engineering. This is a full-time, fully remote position that requires at least 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time for standups and pairing.

What You’ll Do

Machine learning and data science

  • Design, train, evaluate and deploy ML models for classification, clustering, recommendation, NLP and forecasting use cases.
  • Explore, clean and engineer features from product data stored in SQL Server and MongoDB.
  • Define metrics, run experiments and report results clearly to engineering and product stakeholders.
  • Monitor models in production for drift, accuracy and cost, and retrain as needed.

AI and Claude integration

  • Build LLM-powered features using the Claude API: prompt design, tool use, structured outputs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Develop evaluation sets and automated tests to measure LLM output quality, accuracy and safety.
  • Optimize LLM usage for latency and cost (prompt caching, model selection, batching).
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to speed up your own development work.

Working with the product engineering team

  • Package models and AI logic as Python services and REST APIs that the C# (.NET) backend calls.
  • Work with Angular developers to shape how AI features appear and behave in the UI.
  • Write efficient SQL Server queries and MongoDB aggregations, and help design schemas for the data that ML features need.
  • Take part in code reviews, sprint planning and standups, following the team’s Git, CI/CD and testing practices.
  • Document models, data pipelines and APIs so other engineers can support them.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, ML engineering or a similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation and avoiding overfitting.
  • Practical experience building with LLM APIs, ideally Anthropic Claude: prompt engineering, tool use, RAG and output evaluation.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs in Python (FastAPI or Flask).
  • Working knowledge of SQL (SQL Server preferred) and a NoSQL document database (MongoDB preferred).
  • Comfortable with Git, code reviews and Agile/Scrum workflows.
  • Clear written and spoken English (Upper-Intermediate or higher) for daily collaboration with a distributed team.
  • Proactive written communication: status updates, clear questions and documented decisions.
  • Ownership of features from prototype to production, not just notebooks.
  • Curiosity about new AI capabilities and the judgment to know when a simpler approach is better.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with vector databases or embedding search (e.g., MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone).
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or the Claude Agent SDK.
  • Reading-level familiarity with C# / .NET and Angular / TypeScript, enough to trace how your services are called.
  • MLOps experience: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, model versioning (MLflow or similar) and cloud deployment (Azure or AWS).
  • Prior work on a multi-tenant B2B SaaS product.
  • NLP work on unstructured business text such as documents, emails or research content.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security practices for customer data used in AI features.

Recruitment Process

  1. Pre-screen call with a Recruitment Manager.
  2. Technical interview with DOIT Software.
  3. Online call with the client.

When you apply for the role, please answer the following questions:

  1. How much professional experience do you have in data science / ML engineering? Include your main speciality.
  2. Do you have strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn?
  3. Do you have hands-on experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow)?
  4. How much production experience do you have with LLMs and RAG?
  5. Do you have experience building and consuming REST APIs in Python (FastAPI or Flask)?
  6. What is your current level of proficiency in English?
  7. Please share your monthly salary expectations (gross amount in USD).
  8. When can you start?

item.title: Senior Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer в Svitla Systems, Inc., Київ, Львів, за кордоном
item.description:
Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Senior Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in Ukraine. Our client is an American mobile computing company.

The ideal candidate combines strong programming skills, hands-on experience training and deploying deep learning models, and a systematic approach to failure analysis. You will work with scene text and document understanding, practical multi-view geometry, and rigorous benchmarking, as part of a team collaborating on shared codebases and remote projects.

Requirements

  • Strong programming skills in Python and key libraries such as NumPy and OpenCV.
  • Hands-on experience training and deploying deep learning models in PyTorch.
  • Solid background in scene text and document understanding: text detection (segmentation- or regression-based), text recognition (CTC-, attention-, or transformer-based), sequence decoding and confidence calibration, grammar- or lexicon-constrained decoding, and reading-order and layout grouping for key information extraction.
  • Practical multi-view geometry experience: local feature detection, description, and matching; homography estimation; robust estimation such as RANSAC and its variants; inlier analysis; and perspective warping.
  • Ability to debug chained coordinate-space transforms and polygon geometry.
  • Systematic failure analysis skills: building an error taxonomy over a pipeline, turning anecdotal failures into reproducible test cases and quantified failure buckets, and running controlled ablations that isolate the responsible stage.
  • Experience with dataset construction and curation, augmentation, synthetic and degraded data generation, domain adaptation, fine-tuning, and hyperparameter sweeps.
  • Discipline to benchmark rigorously before and after every change against tracked baselines.
  • Proficiency with Hydra for configuration management and Weights & Biases for experiment tracking.
  • Experience working on remote GPU servers and clusters and in containerized environments.
  • Experience with Git and GitHub for version control.
  • A habit of testing numerical and geometric code.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team, particularly on shared codebases and remote projects.
  • Clear technical writing, including analysis reports that support decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Own and improve the OCR pipeline end to end.
  • Diagnose failures on real customer images and identify root causes.
  • Develop and optimize text detection, recognition, decoding, and layout components.
  • Work with image geometry, feature matching, homographies, RANSAC, and perspective transforms.
  • Build and curate datasets, run augmentations and fine-tuning, and conduct controlled experiments.
  • Benchmark changes against tracked baselines and document measurable improvements.
  • Use PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy, Hydra, Weights & Biases, GPUs, containers, and Git.
  • Collaborate with the team on shared codebases and provide clear technical analysis.

We offer

  • US and EU projects based on advanced technologies.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.
  • Regular performance appraisals to support your growth.
  • Flexibility in workspace, either remote or in one of our development offices.
  • Comprehensive medical insurance, including dental and massages.
  • Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development.
  • Sport reimbursement program for onsite and online activities.
  • Bonuses for recommendations of new employees.
  • Bonuses for article writing, public talks, and other activities.
  • 20 vacation days, 10 national holidays and 5 sick leaves.
  • Maternity leave policy and family days off.
  • Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla.

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer в PLANEKS, We're a fully remote team thus we do not have an office. Most of our developers are based in Ukraine., віддалено
item.description:
What We Offer

  • 100% remote work opportunity and flexitime — choose working hours between 8:00-20:00 Kyiv time.
  • Personal Growth Budget in USD (Travel, Health & Psychotherapy, Sports, Education & Training, Software, Work Equipment).
  • Competitive compensation in USD with regular salary reviews.
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.
  • Continuous professional growth through mentorship, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • English Speaking Club with a native speaker.
  • Access to AI tools, including coding assistants for engineers and LLM subscriptions for non-technical specialists.
  • Projects with clients across Europe and North America across FinTech, Logistics, Hospitality, E-commerce, Legal, Music, and other industries.
  • Transparent processes, flat management structure, and a supportive team culture.

About the Role

  • We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to become one of the strongest technical contributors on the team.
  • The single most important thing we’re looking for is experience scaling a SaaS product. We want someone who has already seen what happens as a live platform grows: increasing complexity, technical debt, scaling bottlenecks, evolving data models, unreliable integrations, and engineering decisions that worked at one stage but became expensive at the next.
  • This is a hands-on senior engineering role with strong technical leadership expectations. You will design and write production code, own substantial systems end to end, influence architectural decisions, challenge technical direction when needed, and raise the engineering level of the people around you.

Project

FinTech SaaS platform built for the restaurant and hospitality industry. Our products handle tip pooling and payouts, payroll, reporting and compliance, labor and operational data, and integrations with the systems hospitality businesses already use. The platform is live, serves thousands of customers and moves millions of dollars.

Required Hard Skills

  • Several years operating at Senior Engineer level on a SaaS product that grew significantly while you were there. You have seen a system become meaningfully bigger and understand the problems that tend to arrive next.
  • Strong Python and Django / Django REST Framework experience, or deep experience in a closely comparable backend stack.
  • Strong React and TypeScript experience, with the ability to work effectively across backend and frontend when required.
  • Strong PostgreSQL and data modeling skills. You should be comfortable designing schemas that can evolve as the business grows into new products and safely changing them once they contain production data.
  • Production experience with asynchronous and distributed workloads using Celery or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of API design and third-party integrations, including failure handling, retries, idempotency, data consistency, reconciliation, and situations where the system on the other side is unreliable or outside your control.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and the ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions inside a large existing codebase rather than only designing systems from scratch.
  • Experience identifying and addressing performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability problems before they become critical.
  • Strong testing practices and experience safely evolving systems that must remain operational while they are being changed.
  • Production experience with Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, error tracking, and observability.
  • Strong Linux knowledge.
  • Sound judgment about technical debt: knowing the difference between an acceptable shortcut and one that will create significant problems later, and being able to improve a system while it remains in production.
  • Everyday experience with using AI agents for work (Claude Code or Codex). Familiar with configuring AI toolset, understanding pros and cons of modern AI.

Current Stack

  • Django / DRF, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Traefik, Datadog, Sentry, Mailgun, GitHub Workflows.
  • Next.js, MUI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest.

Nice to Have

  • FinTech or financial systems experience, particularly payments, payouts, ledgers, reconciliation, payroll, banking, audit trails, or other systems where financial correctness matters.
  • Experience with restaurant or hospitality technology, including POS, scheduling, workforce management, payroll, or similar systems.
  • Experience with high-volume or business-critical third-party integrations.
  • Experience improving a system with meaningful legacy code or technical debt while the product remained actively developed.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
  • Experience improving engineering practices across a team rather than only within your own work.
  • Experience as a Senior Engineer in a company of roughly 20–200 people, where your role included helping decide what technical work actually mattered.

Required Soft Skills

  • Ability to take technical ownership beyond your own tickets and think about the health of the product and engineering system as a whole.
  • Strong engineering judgment and the confidence to challenge technical decisions constructively, including decisions made by Staff Engineers and engineering leadership.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Problems will not always arrive fully specified, and part of your job is asking the questions that make them clear before code gets written.
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A strong teaching mindset. You explain your reasoning, document important decisions, review code seriously, and make the engineers around you better rather than becoming the only person who understands a difficult system.
  • Comfortable taking leadership during difficult technical situations without waiting for someone else to define every step of the solution.
  • Strong written communication and self-direction. The team is distributed across Canada and Europe with limited live overlap, so you need to communicate clearly asynchronously and drive your own work.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own substantial systems end to end

  • Take meaningful problems that have been identified but not fully solved and work with Staff Engineers and Product to determine the right technical approach.
  • Own complex initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, migration, testing, rollout, and production monitoring.
  • Design not only for the expected path, but also for what happens when something goes wrong in production.
  • Remain responsible for the systems you build once they are carrying real customer data and real money.

2. Help strengthen the architecture of a growing product

  • Work closely with Staff Engineers and the VP of Engineering on architectural decisions and technical direction.
  • Understand the existing architecture and identify where today’s decisions may create tomorrow’s problems.
  • Identify areas where the platform may struggle as product complexity, integrations, customers, data volume, and transaction volume increase.
  • Challenge architectural decisions constructively when you see a better approach.
  • Help evolve the architecture incrementally through small, safe improvements rather than unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.

3. Protect correctness, reliability, and engineering quality

  • Treat financial correctness as a first-class engineering concern.
  • Design for reconciliation and auditability: how we prove a number is correct, understand how it was produced, and detect discrepancies before customers do.
  • Use Datadog, Sentry, logs, production data, and other signals to identify recurring problems and their root causes.
  • Improve observability, error handling, testing, deployment safety, performance, and operational reliability.
  • Make sure recurring production problems are solved systematically rather than repeatedly patched.

4. Own technically difficult areas of the product

  • Lead work involving complex third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, data synchronization, reconciliation, migrations, and failure recovery.
  • Design systems that behave predictably when external APIs fail, requests are duplicated, jobs execute late, or data arrives in an unexpected state.
  • Work closely with Product to make technical feasibility and engineering constraints visible before implementation begins.
  • Help break large technical initiatives into safe, incremental pieces that can be built, migrated, and released without unnecessarily putting the existing platform at risk.

5. Make the case for important technical work

  • Identify technical debt, platform investment, reliability work, and architectural improvements that may not naturally appear on the product roadmap.
  • Distinguish between debt that can safely remain and debt that is materially affecting reliability, engineering speed, or future product development.
  • Make the business and technical case for that work using evidence rather than engineering preference alone.
  • Help sequence improvements so they support product development rather than competing with it unnecessarily.

6. Raise the level of the engineering team

  • Be a strong technical reference point for other engineers.
  • Review architecture, designs, and pull requests with a focus on correctness, reasoning, and long-term maintainability.
  • Explain why you would make a decision differently rather than simply leaving a verdict.
  • Mentor engineers through reviews, pairing, technical discussions, and example.
  • Document important knowledge and decisions so understanding stays with the team rather than with one individual.
  • Take leadership when a difficult technical problem crosses multiple areas or engineers.

7. Remain hands-on

  • Design and write production code across the backend and frontend.
  • Take direct ownership of technically difficult or risky work when appropriate.
  • Debug difficult production issues and establish their root causes.
  • Read and understand the existing codebase before changing it.
  • Build enough direct knowledge of the platform to ensure your technical decisions are grounded in how the system actually works.

Who this position is not for

  • This is not a role for someone whose definition of seniority is simply delivering more complicated tickets.
  • If you prefer receiving clearly defined tickets and technical solutions and then implementing them, this role will probably be frustrating.
  • It is not a management role. You won’t have direct reports or headcount responsibility. Leadership here comes through technical ownership, judgment, mentoring, reviews, and influence.
  • It is also not a Staff Engineer role. Our Staff Engineers and VP of Engineering set the overall technical direction and architecture. You will help shape that direction, challenge it when needed, and fully own the design and implementation of substantial systems within it.
  • It is not a greenfield role. You will be joining a live platform with thousands of customers and a roadmap that does not pause while technical improvements are made. Much of the work involves understanding existing systems, migrating them safely, and improving them incrementally rather than replacing them.
  • If you naturally ask what happens when the system gets significantly larger, how it fails, how we know the data is correct, and what today’s shortcut will cost us a year from now, you’ll recognize the work.

Things You Should Know Before Applying

  • The engineering challenge is no longer simply building features quickly. It is continuing to ship while improving reliability, scalability, architecture, and the technical foundation required for significant year-over-year growth
  • There is technical debt. Part of your job is determining which debt actually matters, making its impact visible, and helping address it without stopping product development.
  • Requirements will sometimes be incomplete. We expect you to help shape the solution rather than wait for perfect specifications.
  • You will be expected to disagree when necessary, propose better approaches, and explain the reasoning behind them.

item.title: Python-розробник (Web Scraping) в Лінія магазинів EVA, Дніпро, віддалено
item.description:
Основні обов’язки:
Розробка та підтримка скраперів для різних типів джерел (статичний HTML, API, сайти з JS-рендерингом та антибот-захистом). Запис і трансформація зібраних даних у бази компанії з дотриманням наявних ETL-процесів. Побудова рішень, стійких до блокувань, змін розмітки та rate-limit джерел.

Обов’язкові вимоги
Впевнений Python (включно з асинхронним підходом — asyncio). Практичний досвід скрапінгу: requests/httpx, парсинг через BeautifulSoup/lxml/parsel, бажано Scrapy. Розуміння HTTP на глибокому рівні: headers, cookies, sessions, робота з проксі та їх ротацією. Досвід протидії антибот-захисту (fingerprinting, retries, обхід rate-limit). SQL і практичний досвід роботи з реляційними БД — запис даних, батч-вставки, робота з наявними схемами. Meet the team!

The Security team partners across the company to help Preply grow safely and sustainably. We are responsible for platform security, application and product security, security operations, and incident response. We work closely with SRE, Data teams, Engineering teams, and our GRC function to make security practical, measurable, and scalable.

We work in small teams, which means you’ll have high ownership, real influence on technical decisions, and the opportunity to drive meaningful improvements across the company. We promote self-direction, strong collaboration, and a culture where trust and clear communication matter.

We’ve reached 90%+ adoption of AI coding tools across engineering, and we’re now moving towards more autonomous, AI-Augmented development at scale. At Preply, engineers have direct access to the best tools available, with the freedom to use them fully and experiment as they build.

We have diverse technical challenges that will allow you to develop your skills across the stack — sometimes we write about them in our Engineering Blog! Please, also visit our Tech Radar and our YouTube channel to learn more about the technologies we use at Preply!

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own platform security across AWS, Kubernetes, and GCP, with a strong focus on detection, alerting, and incident response readiness
  • Lead key platform security initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout and iteration
  • Act as a strong technical voice in defining how platform security is designed, implemented, and operated at Preply
  • Evolve our monitoring from “we have a SIEM” to a detection and response capability that is effective, trusted, and actionable
  • Work hands-on with our current tooling, including Datadog as our SIEM, Okta as our primary IdP, and a range of SaaS platforms
  • Drive cross-functional platform security initiatives from problem definition to production rollout, partnering with SRE, Data, Engineering, and GRC
  • Strengthen cloud and platform security across AWS and Kubernetes, with expanding scope in GCP, through practical guardrails, secure patterns, and automation
  • Improve the robustness of access to internal infrastructure, including identity, privileged access, and auditability
  • Improve security of Kubernetes deployments, including cluster and workload security, policy enforcement, and secure workload identity patterns
  • Mature detection and response capability using Datadog
  • Improve log coverage and data quality (cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, identity, and key SaaS)
  • Build and tune actionable detections with clear severity, ownership, and expected frequency
  • Reduce noise through correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and continuous tuning
  • Establish repeatable triage workflows and clear escalation paths, being part of the Security on-call rotations
  • Create investigation playbooks and runbooks so alerts can be handled consistently and quickly
  • Partner with Data teams to improve monitoring for suspicious activity and sensitive access patterns, with an emphasis on practical, high-signal alerting
  • Improve secrets management and reduce exposure risk across CI/CD and runtime
  • Build security automation that makes the secure path the easy path for engineers

What you need to succeed:

  • Strong experience securing cloud and platform environments, especially AWS and Kubernetes, and the ability to extend that security approach into GCP
  • Hands-on experience driving and delivering technical security initiatives end-to-end in production environments
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, and comfort working with CI/CD and infrastructure as code
  • Practical experience improving identity and access security, with strong familiarity with Okta event monitoring and identity-focused detection patterns
  • Experience building or maturing security operations capability, especially turning SIEM inputs into reliable operational outcomes (triage, runbooks, tuning, and measurable improvement)
  • Experience improving logging coverage and signal quality, and building detections that are actionable rather than noisy (experience with Datadog SIEM is a plus)
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence decisions across SRE, Data, Engineering, and GRC
  • Business-oriented mindset and comfort making cost-benefit tradeoffs
  • Strong communication skills. Minimum C1 English level.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and partner effectively with SRE during incidents.
